description: This header file declares APIs for handling JSON requests in the Host Interface component of a TR-069 device management system. It includes function prototypes for starting/stopping an HTTP server, handling incoming JSON messages, and parsing/generating JSON payloads.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStart
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server to listen for JSON requests.

methods.name: hostIf_HTTPJsonMsgHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON messages from the HTTP client, processes them, and initiates response.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStop
methods.description: Stops the HTTP server handling JSON requests.
